mission: Make every repository capability discoverable, attributable, testable, observable, and connected without duplicating runtimes.
reporting: After an authorized repository scan, publish found/proposed/changed/verified/blocked/unknown results and link benchmark evidence.
migration: Preserve legacy identities as aliases until capability parity, dependency parity, route parity, permission parity, observability parity, and E2E regression parity are proven.
principle: One governed capability may be reused by many products; do not create another bot when a capability, adapter, workflow, or benchmark is the correct abstraction.
